message: No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local filesystem paths (ROOT_DIR, IMG_DIR) with no checksum verification, signature validation, or authenticated remote fetch.
No detected label flipping detection: The code performs no checks on label distributions, validation of label values against an expected set, or any label-noise detection tooling before training.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The dataset loading and filtering logic only filters by symbol exclusion and sequence length; there is no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checking, or any other defense against poisoned training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads a pretrained model via '--perception-pretrain' argument (defaulting to 'data/perception-pretrain/model.pth.tar_78.2_match') with no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision visible in the provided code.

No detected label distribution validation: The code builds dataset statistics (len2ids, sym2ids, res2ids) for filtering/curriculum purposes but never performs a class balance check or anomalous-sample detection before training begins.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) is imported or used anywhere in the code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, etc.) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the evaluation code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no hashing, signing, or cryptographic isolation of the test set; while a separate test split is loaded by name in dataset.py, there is no enforcement mechanism preventing the test data from leaking into training or verifying data integrity.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path (evaluate/deduce) directly consumes dataset samples without any shape, range, or schema validation on incoming inputs.

No detected output bounds checks: Beyond logging the percentage of None results, there are no bounds checks, NaN guards, or threshold validations applied to model outputs before they are used or returned.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is not an LLM pipeline; it processes mathematical expression images and parse trees, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
